notes: Figure 1A TEM and 1B XRD characterize seeds from the stated Bi preparation before III–V nanowire growth; the paper does not identify whether those specimens were measured before or after the drying/storage step.
Drying and nitrogen storage are reported workup steps but are not proven to be the exact Figure 1 specimen state.
High-temperature and biphasic failed Bi routes lack full reagent charges and are not separate paired records.
III–V nanowire products are outside this colloidal nanocrystal package.

quality.review_scope: Independent scoped main-text audit accepted the Bi seed method, Figure 1 specimen and measured phase/size. The exact Figure 1 aliquot preparation state and SI remain unverified.
missing_fields: The route charges 0.1 mL as-received Bi(III) 2-ethylhexanoate; reagent density, purity and molar Bi loading are not reported.
Drying technique/time and exact post-isolation ligand coverage are not reported.
Alternative failed Bi reductions lack full charges and do not make distinct supported recipe–structure pairs.
The Figure 1 TEM/XRD cohort is linked to the Bi seed route, but its exact wet, dried or stored aliquot processing state is unreported.
No sample-specific atomic coordinates, refined lattice parameters, or particle size SD are provided; bulk reference cell is external and not training-eligible.
